sources.scientific_reference: Only the user-supplied Chen et al. (2002) article.
sources.status: Figure-4-calibrated, not independent material parameter identification.
sources.density: 920 and 1950 kg/m3 are assumed repository reference values (tests/LMHomogeneousBinder/input), not values recovered from the article.
sources.cp_and_Q: Derived from article Fig4 endpoint fits in analysis/article_inferred_combinations.json.
sources.conductivity: Derived from fitted rho*cp and approximate alpha=r*thermal_length using article r=0.5 cm/s, thermal lengths binder47um/AP33um.
sources.temperature: Cold temperature 300 K is an assumed realization; endpoints identify T0+Q/cp, not T0 separately.
